name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Java Backend Developer | RESTful APIs | JBoss Integration | SQL Databases | Microservices | CI/CD & DevOps
summary: Backend Developer with 10+ years of experience building Java-based backend solutions for the financial sector. Proven expertise in developing RESTful APIs, integrating enterprise systems with JBoss (Fuse, BRMS), and architecting microservices for high-volume transaction processing. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional IT teams to deliver scalable, reliable backend services. Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, unit testing practices, and SQL database optimization.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices for inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily, applying backend engineering best practices across the full delivery lifecycle.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs, reducing average response time by 25–35% through caching strategies, improved error handling, and API versioning.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), cutting deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases to production.
Enforced code quality through unit testing and static analysis (SonarQube), reducing production defects by 30% and improving long-term maintainability.
Partnered closely with product and planning teams to deliver backend solutions aligned with business requirements, improving forecast accuracy across global retail operations.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across the service portfolio, achieving a deployment success rate exceeding 95%.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retailer, enabling scalable inventory processing and real-time decision-making.
Developed microservices in Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations, ensuring reliability under production load.
Integrated enterprise services using JBoss Fuse, implementing asynchronous processing patterns that improved system throughput by 30% and reduced transaction latency.
Centralized business rules with JBoss BRMS, cutting manual intervention by 20–25% and accelerating credit approval workflows.
Designed and delivered RESTful backend services powering digital credit platforms and mobile wallet solutions used in production by thousands of end-users.
Applied fault-tolerant design patterns to distributed financial systems, improving resilience and reducing service downtime.
Automated operational decision logic, eliminating processing bottlenecks and improving end-to-end transaction efficiency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and system performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Built Power BI dashboards that enabled stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions, reducing reporting turnaround from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
